title: Hope, Leslie Townes (Bob)
creator: Encyclopedia of Cleveland History
required_credit: Encyclopedia of Cleveland History, Case Western Reserve University
gloss: Primary biographical source: born Eltham 29 May 1903; family emigrated to Cleveland in March 1908; “when his father was naturalized in December 1920, Hope became a United States citizen”; vaudeville from 1922; solo as “Bob” from 1928; radio, film and the USO; died 27 July 2003.
